ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The left side of the figure marks the 0°, 30°, and 60° latitude lines, indicating a sea area from the equator to higher latitudes; there are land boundaries on both sides of the ocean basin, Jia and Yi are located on the left side, and Bing and Ding are located on the right side. Bing is located on the right side of the ocean basin, at a coastal position near the approximately 30°—60° latitude belt. Then reason: This region is located within the range of the Northern Hemisphere subtropical gyre, and the Northern Hemisphere subtropical gyre generally moves clockwise. Therefore, near the right-side boundary of the ocean basin, the ocean current should flow from higher latitudes to lower latitudes, that is, flow southward.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：图中左侧标出0°、30°、60°纬线，丙位于海盆右侧、30°—60°纬度带附近的沿岸位置。再根据北半球副热带环流顺时针的规律判断，右侧边界上的洋流应从较高纬向较低纬流动，所以丙洋流为向南流。

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：丙位于右侧大陆边缘、30°—60°纬度带附近，图中该纬度带有表示盛行风影响的斜线。再推理：中纬西风把海水推向右侧海盆边界，受大陆阻挡后沿边界向低纬回流，形成东部边界寒流。因此丙的流向是向南流。
